response.overview: A man watches insistently a young woman at the river, causing her great embarrassment and increasing nervousness.  Which are his actual thoughts and intentions?  Where is the border between fantasy and reality?  And how far would he go?  This symbolic and highly innovative drama short film mysteriously takes its curious spectators into the deep intimacy of the sinful and potentially dangerous side of the human nature – closely observing the sensitive relation between the possible attacker and the one being possibly attacked, from the very complex conqueror-conquered / aggressor-victim perspective. https://www.dorobantu-tv.com/o
